title: Browns place Dillon Gabriel on IR, with long-term outlook on all 4 of their QBs remaining unclear

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Browns place Dillon Gabriel on IR, with long-term outlook on all 4 of their QBs remaining unclear
sources.description: The Cleveland Browns will keep four quarterbacks on their initial 53-man roster, and it's hard to tell how strongly they feel about any of them.
